audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagreed with the already-audited mirror on three rows: Level 2, Level 3 and 2+ items.
audit.why: Mirror (ryze__ziggs) records Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Skill. Ours read Ziggs, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Ryze. mirror-fix.js would overwrite ours, and the content whys already argue the mirror's side (whys[1] and whys[2] both say Ziggs out-trades, whys[6] says Ziggs out-scales).
audit.corrected: Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Skill — proposed as paired full/content rows with ratings.

audit.why: Realm Warp (180/160/140s) is a macro tool, not a duel spike, and the page already says so; Ryze's real power spike is mana items, which spikes[2] captures. Satchel Charge's 20s rank-1 cooldown is already written into dontsFull[1] as the mirror recorded.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly claims 'your Q out-ranges Overload'. It does not — Overload is 1000 range and Bouncing Bomb is 850. Separately, nothing states that Rune Prison only ROOTS through Spell Flux; untouched it is a slow.
audit.why: Riot's text: Rune Prison damages and slows, 'If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' Rune Prison and Spell Flux are both 615 range, and Spell Flux is on a 3.5/3.25/3/2.75/2.5s cooldown — so his E, not his W, is the timer that governs your forward steps. Ziggs still wins the early lane, but on Ryze's mana cost and on bounce angles, not on raw range.
audit.corrected: Overload reaches 1000 to your 850 — bait it, do not try to out-range it. Rune Prison is 615 and only roots if Spell Flux is already on you; clean of Flux it is a slow, so break the line the instant his E lands.
sources: kits: ryze Q range 1000, W range 615 + Flux root clause, E range 615 cd 3.5/3.25/3/2.75/2.5

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Rune Prison as the cooldown to track.
audit.why: Rune Prison at 11s is real but toothless without Flux; Spell Flux at 3.5s is what turns it into a root, so the E is the tell.
audit.corrected: Step up while Spell Flux is spent on the wave rather than on you.

edits.before: Level 1 your Q out-ranges Overload, letting you poke Ryze freely.
edits.after: Level 1 Overload reaches 1000 to your 850 — win on his mana, not range.

edits.before: Poke with Q while spacing past Overload range
edits.after: Bait Overload, then Q — he reaches 1000

edits.before: You out-range Ryze's Overload (Q): poke him whenever he steps up, and punish his Rune Prison (W) mana cost by forcing short trades he can't sustain.
edits.after: Rune Prison only roots if Spell Flux (E) is on you first — clean of Flux it is just a 615-range slow, so break the line the instant his E lands and his whole combo dies.

edits.before: Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Rune Prison and Spell Flux both reach 615 — stand past that line and the root cannot start at all.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison (Root): matchup-defining — Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. It governs your forward steps. - W Satchel spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Rune Prison is 11 seconds and only roots through Spell Flux, so the real timer is his E at 3.5s — step up while it is on the wave, not on you. - W Satchel spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

notes: Biggest defect: the page asserted Ziggs out-ranges Overload. Overload is 1000 range, Bouncing Bomb 850 — the claim was backwards and it appeared in whys[0], wants.you[0] and spikes[0]. I corrected those three; the same 'out-ranges' framing survives in early/mid prose and in the generic full-layer lines, which I left because rewriting them all inside the length band would have needed guesswork about the intended replacement. Chart rows 2, 3 and 7 realigned to the already-audited mirror as one atomic group with matched full/content pairs. Packet defect 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice' addressed via breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d with the 615/3.5s numbers.
